title: Embedding coefficient friezes as subpolygons of Conway-Coxeter friezes
author: Michael Cuntz; Thorsten Holm
difficulty_reason: After ordinary positive-integer Ptolemy relations, prime valuations and the Chinese Remainder Theorem, the authored proof still classifies forbidden residue classes by a subpolygon congruence claim and proves that a permitted residue always remains. It constructs compatible positive labels for an added vertex across all prime-power divisors, verifies every new Ptolemy and triangle-gcd relation, and preserves the prime-valuation obstruction through the induction. These custom residue-exclusion and global extension arguments exceed routine qualification exercises and are retained in full.
